correctness.rationale: The pair (u_v,w_v) has neighborhoods differing only at v, forcing all base vertices into every code; nonempty leaf traces force nonempty private-pair selections. Because H is connected of order >=2, base traces contain >=2 base vertices, support traces exactly one, leaves none. Only distinct base closed twins both selecting leaf-only produce collisions; at most one such choice per class is necessary and sufficient. Product of local two-state/one-exception factors yields the polynomial, minimum size/count and root spectrum. Independent direct closed-neighborhood enumeration of K2, P3, K3 cores gives the claimed exact polynomials.
